data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse Kjörðis, meaning 'dark one'. This name was popularized in the Middle Ages due to its association with the Virgin Mary and her dark skin tone. The name Kiersten carries the meaning “Dark one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kiersten usually hope their child will grow to embody dark one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiersten total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
